market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $100 oil, inflation data, and Fed hike risk. Equities likely volatile with sector rotation from tech to energy/defense. Yen strength and currency volatility add noise. Key: CPI/PCE data and Oracle earnings this week will set tone. Expect 3-5% equity drawdown risk if oil sustains $100+ and Fed signals hawkishness.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact (Nvidia forecast, Anthropic/AWS, Dell/HPE records). Energy transition disrupted by lithium chaos but BYD/global EV consolidation continues. Trade wars create fragmentation but domestic manufacturing (GM Canada, Dangote) benefits. 6-12 month: expect rate normalization, AI earnings delivery, and geopolitical premium in energy/defense. Gold and real assets favored as inflation persists.
